items.why: The report lists fitted band positions such as "108.33", "241.34" and "341.11" cm-1, but it never assigns them as Ag1/Ag2/Ag3 modes or says that Ag1 and Ag2 are weaker than Ag3.
The report never links the Ag1/Ag2 positions to thickness; it only gives raw fits per flake.
No caveat appears ("caveats": []), and nothing is said about Ag3 being insensitive to thickness.
There is no thickness ranking; the only comparison is "strongest band of flake A shifts by ..." relative to flake A.
No flake is called a monolayer or bulk; flakes C and B appear only as lists of bands.
Polarization or orientation dependence of intensities is never mentioned; the caveats and limits lists are empty.
"questions_for_user": [] is empty; there is no request for AFM or polarization/orientation information.

wrong_claims.why: The report gives shifts of the strongest (~341 cm-1, Ag3) band relative to flake A, but it never uses them to draw any thickness conclusion.
The report makes no statement about which way Ag1/Ag2 shift with thickness.
